description: One rhythm: the 4pt grid, one spacing scale, one radius scale, one column grid. Space declares hierarchy — s4 to s8 is one unit, s12 to s16 siblings, s24 and up different sections.
notes: Off-scale gaps and paddings are never used; 1px belongs to hairline borders, which are strokes, not space.

Radius is proportional to base 10, scales with surface SIZE rather than importance, and nests concentrically (child radius = parent radius - inset). radiusFull means circle or capsule, never 'very round rectangle'.
D9: density resolves from the primary input device. It is layout-affecting and therefore session-stable — it MUST NOT flip mid-session on hybrid devices.

base.description: Every other radius is a proportional multiplier of this.

compact.description: Semantic, not device names. A desktop window dragged narrow IS compact and gets the compact composition.

feed.description: A phone-proportioned max: the feed never becomes a grid, at any width.

headerHeight.description: Compact and medium. The title aligns to the content column, not the screen edge.

headerHeightExpanded.description: Expanded and up. Chrome gains height with the layout, not with the type scale.

minTarget.description: The visual glyph may be smaller; the hit area may not.

compact.description: Resolved per layout scope, never once per screen.

media.description: Media grids at every width — the grid reads as one surface.

strokeXs.description: The system's one sanctioned stroke deviation: an optical floor at 16px. Never applied per-component.

side.description: D25. A first-class theme token that flips ALL thumb-arc placements together for left/right-handed reach and RTL. Values: start | end.

swipeActionCell.description: One swipe-action cell: a comfortable touch target with room for an icon and a label. Wider than the 44 minimum on purpose. At most two per side.

leadingAvatar.description: The list leading slot when it holds an avatar, at radius full. The separator inset is measured from it.
